title: Ethical Audit of a Prompt
description: Review a problematic prompt, identify ethical and practical flaws, and rewrite it responsibly.
problemStatement:
A colleague wrote this prompt for an AI that writes biographies for a company website:

> 'Write a short biography for our new manager, Alex. They are really smart and have a great personality. Make it sound impressive.'

Your task:
1. Identify at least three problems with this prompt from an ethical, clarity, and inclusivity standpoint.
2. Rewrite the prompt to produce a fair, accurate, and professional biography. Include all necessary details (you may invent appropriate background) and ethical considerations.
3. Explain how your new prompt addresses each problem.

Provide the original prompt critique, your rewritten prompt, and the explanation.
hints: Problems: vague (no facts → potential hallucination), subjective language ("really smart"), lacks specifics to avoid bias, no mention of gender‑neutral language.
Good bio prompt: provide actual facts (years of experience, achievements), request professional tone, specify length, include diversity‑conscious instruction (e.g., 'use gender‑neutral language').
expectedOutput:
Critique: 1) No factual input – AI will invent achievements, risking inaccuracy. 2) 'Really smart' and 'great personality' are subjective and could lead to clichés or biased descriptions. 3) No tone or format specified; could come off as boastful or unprofessional. No inclusivity guidance.

Rewritten prompt: 'Write a 100‑word professional biography for Alex, a new manager, using these facts: 10 years in project management, certified PMP, led a team of 15, known for improving on‑time delivery by 20%. Use a respectful, neutral tone. Avoid subjective adjectives like "smart" or "charismatic". Use gender‑neutral pronouns. Keep it factual and inspiring.'

Explanation: The new prompt grounds the output in real data, removes subjective words, sets a professional tone, and includes a diversity‑conscious instruction.
